title: sos_origin: verify_sos_origin_gated does not bind origin_addr to AddrForKey(pubkey)
description: 3x codereview on b7z9.121.4 (correctness finding 2): rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs:218-229 — the module doc (:13-18) states origin IPv6 MUST equal upstream AddrForKey and the gate keys on origin_addr, but nothing checks origin_addr == origin_addr_from_pubkey(pubkey). A valid signer can rotate/spoof origin addresses; each fresh address is a new gate entry where any first sequence is accepted, voiding the replay gate. Python parity (same parameter shape), so a contract gap not a parity break; no in-tree callers yet. Fix: derive-and-check inside the gated path (mirror sign_sos_origin_for_key) or document the caller obligation on the fn.
